newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Ramos undergoes surgery - officials.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Ramos undergoes surgery - officials.

text.p: Philippines President Fidel Ramos underwent cardiovascular surgery on Monday and was in good condition, senior government officials said.
Agriculture Secretary Salvador Escudero told reporters that the surgery was successful and the president was in "super" condition.
"I understand it (the operation) is over," Escudero said. He said further details would be announced by the presidential palace later in the day.

The president's executive secretary Ruben Torres said the operation lasted a little over an hour and confirmed that Ramos was recovering well. Senate President Ernesto Maceda earlier said the president was to have undergone cardiovascular surgery.
Ramos, 68, was admitted to hospital on Sunday and doctors initially said he was to undergo checks following his confinement to bed the previous weekend for a throat infection.
But television reports have said he was tested for a blockage in an artery. There was no immediate confirmation of the reports.
